# runr_group (Resource)

A group (team) of members. Members get the group's organization-wide `role` and the project access granted to the group (`runr_project_access` with `group_id`). Needs `groups.manage` (and `roles.manage` to set the role). Members synced from single sign-on (source `sso`) are kept by the SSO group mapping and are not part of `members`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Members get the group's organization-wide role and the project access granted to the group.
resource "runr_group" "platform" {
  name        = "platform"
  description = "Platform team"
  role        = "viewer"
  members     = ["grace@example.com", "alan"] # user ids, e-mail addresses or usernames
}

# Deploy rights on one project for the whole group.
resource "runr_project_access" "platform_orders" {
  project_id = runr_project.orders.id
  group_id   = runr_group.platform.id
  role       = runr_role.release_manager.key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name (unique).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `members` (Set of String) Members, each given by user id, e-mail address or username. Unset: Terraform leaves the membership alone; an empty set removes every manually added member.
- `role` (String) Organization-wide role of the members (a built-in role key or `runr_role.<name>.key`). Unset: the group grants project access only.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <group id or name>; members stay unmanaged until the configuration sets them
terraform import runr_group.platform platform
```
